scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others -n api,worker,web,api-ts,worker-ts "npm run dev -w @zhiheng/api" "npm run dev -w @zhiheng/worker" "npm run dev -w @zhiheng/web" "npm run watch -w @zhiheng/api" "npm run watch -w @zhiheng/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @zhiheng/contracts && npm run build -w @zhiheng/config && npm run build -w @zhiheng/resources
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
